name: Vampire Spawn
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
languages: the languages it knew in life

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The vampire regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point and isn't in sunlight or running water. If it takes radiant damage or damage from holy water, this trait doesn't function at the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The vampire can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Vampire Weaknesses
entries: Forbiddance, harmed by running water (20 acid damage), stake to the heart, sunlight hypersensitivity (20 radiant damage).

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The vampire makes two attacks, only one of which can be a bite attack.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}8 ({@damage 2d4 + 3}) slashing damage. Instead of damage, the vampire can grapple the target (escape {@dc 13}).

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one willing creature, or a creature that is grappled, incapacitated, or restrained. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) necrotic damage. The target's hit point maximum is reduced by the necrotic damage taken, and the vampire regains that many hit points.

fluffEntries: **Cria de Osybus:** caçadores da Casa. Agarram e mordem; recuam para a névoa ao tomar dano radiante.
